archivewikiimport-desc: Restore pages, revision history and image bundles from Internet Archive wiki dumps
right-archivewikiimport: Import wiki dumps from Internet Archive
archivewikiimport-intro: Restore a MediaWiki XML dump and an optional image bundle from Internet Archive. All revisions present in the selected dump will be imported.
archivewikiimport-source: Internet Archive item URL or identifier
archivewikiimport-preview-warning: This preview lists available files, not verified page or revision counts. Full history is recoverable only if the dump contains it. Images require a separate bundle. Site settings, extensions, accounts and image upload history are not restored. Existing page histories will be merged; existing image files will be skipped. A fresh destination wiki is recommended. The background job will check content models and common extension markup before importing pages; missing content handlers pause the run for review.
archivewikiimport-ack: I have checked the source and its reuse permissions, and understand that this imports content and merges page histories into this wiki. There is no automatic undo.
archivewikiimport-ack-required: Review and acknowledge the import before starting.
archivewikiimport-report-help: Keep this URL to return to the report. Refresh to check progress. If a worker stopped, resume the run; completed pages and image entries are skipped. A worker already running will continue. Revisions processed may include revisions already present.
archivewikiimport-scan-counts: Scanned $1 pages and $2 revisions before importing.
archivewikiimport-unknown-provider: No provider identified among the installed extensions; a compatible content-handler extension is required.
archivewikiimport-dependencies-help: Missing content handlers pause the import before pages are written. Enable their extensions, then resume. Tag and parser-function matches are suggestions: they may occur in examples or historical revisions and do not prove that an extension is required. These checks do not detect every extension or compatibility requirement.
archivewikiimport-replace-mainpage: Replace the untouched default main page with the newest archived version. Preserve the full history and add a restoration edit. Locally edited main pages are kept.
archivewikiimport-mainpage-restored: The archived main page was made current. Its original history and the default page revision have been preserved.
archivewikiimport-queue-intro: Imports for this wiki, newest update first. Active imports include queued, running, failed and paused runs. Choose All statuses to include completed imports. Open a report for details and available resume actions.
archivewikiimport-active-limit: Active imports: $1 of $2 allowed for this wiki. Queued and running imports count toward the limit; paused, failed and completed imports do not.
archivewikiimport-daily-limit: New imports today: $1 of $2 allowed for this wiki. Resets at $3 ($4). Resuming an existing import does not use another daily allowance.
archivewikiimport-stalled: This worker has stopped sending heartbeats. Recovery will resume the import only after its worker lock is released. A worker still holding the lock requires operator investigation.
archivewikiimport-recovery: Automatic recovery attempts without committed progress: $1 of $2.
